creator: elidholm
title: Edvin's Glove80 developer layout
notes: Personal Swedish sv-SE QWERTY developer layout with home-row mods and Symbols, Navigation, Numbers, Workbench, and Mouse layers. Mouse HID pointing support is enabled. The Factory layer is for key-switch testing and has no mapped exit; power-cycle the keyboard to return to Base.
